examples.pie: wíHre bʰudʰdʰí. ḱwónes yuǵHént. ḱoph₂óns dʰéyǵʰesi h₁épi ḱlush₁yóh₂. téḱneh₂ sl̥h₂gʷdʰí gʷowsth₂óy-kʷe kudʰsó. somHós túH wikési? bʰréh₂tr̥bʰis moy ḱóm wikóh₂. nu pótni dr̥mdʰí. pótey te deywṓs ph₂sih₁ént.
examples.en: Husband, wake up! The dogs have become restless. I hear hooves at the wall. Take the children and hide in the cow-stall. Will you fight alone? I will fight with my brothers. Run now, wife! Husband, may the gods guard you.

examples.pie: ǵĺ̥h₂ow toy nos kápros ǵr̥h₂nóm h₂éḱh₃t. bʰréh₂tēr toy tóm káprom stérgeti ne me ḱlowséyeti. nu moy bʰréh₂trey mléwHoh₂. h₁ésmey mluHdʰí. káprom Hwérowos. h₁ím Hwérowos mē-kʷe wikṓwos. kápros h₂egʰós wé swésorh₁e.
examples.en: Sister-in-law, your goat has eaten our grain! Your brother loves that goat; he does not listen to me. Then I will speak to my brother. Speak to him! Let us shut the goat in. Let us shut him in, and let us not fight. The goat is bad; we two are sisters.

examples.pie: pótni h₁eǵóh₂ wiHrṓm ḱéwh₁istos. pótey túH ph₃tós. uksnéh₁ wikṓh₂. uksénm̥ wédʰe. uksḗn te gʷʰéneti. ne kʷosmōd dedwóyh₂e. nu kʷíd dʰǵʰémi légʰyesi? dʰéǵʰōm Hyowdʰéyeto. médʰu moy dh₃dʰí. wódr̥ toy déh₃oh₂ sésesi-kʷe.
examples.en: Wife, I am the strongest of the men! You are drunk, husband. I will fight with the bull! Bring the bull! The bull will strike you down. I fear nothing. Then why are you lying on the ground? The earth moved. Give me mead. I will give you water, and you will sleep.

root.gloss: to vibrate, tremble, oscillate; to turn, rotate
to twist, wind, weave, plait; to wrap, enclose, cover
to chase, pursue; to suppress, persecute

to become accustomed, used to; to learn
